function: Excluded (above_phy): multi-agent DDPG learns UAV trajectory, UAV CPU-frequency allocation, and task offloading ratios for mobile edge computing. p. 1: "UAV trajectory, resource allocation, and task offloading policy".
notes: Reason above_phy. p. 1: "the UAV and the IDs individually determine their MEC strategies, i.e., UAV trajectory, resource allocation, and task offloading policy". The resource allocated is computing, not radio: p. 5, the UAV solution action f(t) "stands for a collection of the CPU frequencies", and the ID action is the offloading ratio. Uplink and downlink transmit powers are fixed (p. 4, rates (7)-(8); p. 10 Table I: 1 W and 10 W), so no power, radio resource, or beam is learned and the aerial-link clause does not apply. The learned message actions are coordination signaling between agents (p. 6), not a physical-layer function. PDF is arXiv 2407.03280v1, Cooperative Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods for UAV-aided Mobile Edge Computing Networks; it does not print the DOI.
